headline: Six Sectors See Base Turnover as Fighting Intensifies
war_summary: By day 682 of War 140 the front remains split, but the pace of strategic‑base exchanges has accelerated since the last edition. Callahans Passage still records the war’s highest cumulative losses — over 300,000 combined — though hourly casualty rates have cooled sharply. Dead Lands and Weathered Expanse each added tens of thousands of new casualties in the past 24 hours; Weathered Expanse alone logged roughly 7,700 Colonial and 8,700 Warden losses. Enlistment surges continue in the most contested zones: Weathered Expanse (about 11 per hour), Kuura Strand (7.5 per hour), Marban Hollow (10.5 per hour), Nevish Line (28 per hour), and Olavis Wake (1.5 per hour). Base‑ownership changes were reported in nine regions over the last day, led by Weathered Expanse (46 events across five hot bases), Kuura Strand (31 events, five bases), Marban Hollow (26 events, two bases), Nevish Line (23 events, four bases), Olavis Wake (16 events, two bases) and Pari Peak (15 events, three bases). Linn Mercy, Stlican Shelf, Stonecradle and Farranac Coast also saw limited turnover. Elsewhere the line has been static, with no captures recorded.
